## Top Marks — G4 unicorn

**Who he is.** The blue unicorn on the examination panel when young Twilight Sparkle tries to hatch Spike’s egg at Princess Celestia’s School for Gifted Unicorns. He gets an amusingly impatient moment: a yawn while Twilight struggles. [Episode transcript: “The Cutie Mark Chronicles”](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/The_Cutie_Mark_Chronicles)

**Look.** Light cornflower-blue coat, short white mane and tail, yellow-gold eyes, a horn, and a **gold laurel-wreath cutie mark**. He wears a collared shirt, tie and sweater at the exam. See the [unicorn character listing](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Unicorn_ponies) and [cutie-mark index](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_cutie_marks).

**Name.** **Top Marks** is an **officially licensed merchandise name**, used on Enterplay’s 2014 *The Crystal Games* collectible-card-game card **#59 (uncommon)**, with the subtitle **“Long-winded Lecturer.”** He is **not named aloud** in the episode; the card subtitle is not a spoken title or established separate identity. [Card listing](https://www.mawo-cards.com/fk/My-little-Pony/Einzelkarten/Boosterserien/The-Cristal-Games/576_Top-Marks---Long-winded-Lecturer)

**Speech and appearances.** His clear television appearance is **S1E23, “The Cutie Mark Chronicles,”** as one of Twilight’s entrance examiners. The transcript assigns him a **yawn, but no words**; no individual voice actor was verified. A secondary character index also places him beside Ponet and Gingersnap in **IDW *My Little Pony Micro-Series* #8, page 5**—a comic appearance, not extra television dialogue. [Ponet’s comic-appearance index](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Ponet)
